# Class: DecalRenderer

#### Combine()

```ts
Combine(...warps): DecalWarpSampler;
```

Arguments apply left to right: Combine(A, B) maps p to B * A * p.

##### Parameters

###### warps

...readonly [`DecalWarpInput`](../type-aliases/DecalWarpInput.md)[]

##### Returns

[`DecalWarpSampler`](../type-aliases/DecalWarpSampler.md)

#### FromPoints()

```ts
FromPoints(
   from,
   to,
   maxStretch?,
   overlap?
): DecalWarpSampler;
```

Fit the tangent footprint between two world-space points, centered halfway between them.
Preserve its crosswise width and do not shrink below its original length along the connection.
Overlap extends the fitted length equally beyond both ends; the stretch cap can limit coverage.
Point vectors are read at placement time, so callers can update them between collision events.
Base texture rotation is applied before this deformation, as with the other warp factories.

##### Parameters

###### from

`Vector3`

Previous world-space contact point.

###### to

`Vector3`

Current world-space contact point.

###### maxStretch?

`number` = `4`

Maximum length multiplier; defaults to 4 and is clamped to at least 1.

###### overlap?

`number` = `1`

Multiplier of the fitted length; 1 fits, 1.2 adds 20% overlap. Default/minimum 1.

##### Returns

[`DecalWarpSampler`](../type-aliases/DecalWarpSampler.md)

#### FromRay()

```ts
FromRay(maxStretch?): DecalWarpSampler;
```

Stretch along the placement ray. maxStretch caps the length multiplier (default 4, minimum 1).

##### Parameters

###### maxStretch?

`number` = `4`

##### Returns

[`DecalWarpSampler`](../type-aliases/DecalWarpSampler.md)

#### FromVelocity()

```ts
FromVelocity(maxStretch?, factor?): DecalWarpSampler;
```

Projectively splatter forward along world-space incoming motion, anchoring the impact and rear extent.
Total extent along motion scales by min(maxStretch, 1 + factor * world-space tangential speed).
The rear remains close to its original shape while the front stretches and flares; the footprint is off-center.

##### Parameters

###### maxStretch?

`number` = `4`

Maximum length multiplier; defaults to 4 and is clamped to at least 1.

###### factor?

`number` = `1`

Additional stretch per world unit/second of tangential speed; defaults to 1, minimum 0.

##### Returns

[`DecalWarpSampler`](../type-aliases/DecalWarpSampler.md)

<a id="querydecals"></a>

### queryDecals()

```ts
queryDecals(
   receiver,
   position,
   radius,
   normal?
): readonly DecalInstance[];
```

Nearby persistent decals, nearest first. Inputs use world space; normals filter incompatible surfaces.
The inclusive query radius is independent of minDistance and does not alter any decal.

`Object3D`
